name: Gym Team T-Shirt
description: Official climbing gym team shirt. Moisture-wicking fabric, relaxed fit for full range of motion. Available in all sizes.

name: Climber Starter Kit
description: Everything a new climber needs. Quality climbing shoes, chalk bag with chalk ball, finger tape, and a technique guidebook.

name: Lifetime Founding Member
description: One-time payment for lifetime unlimited access. Includes all future gym expansions, exclusive founding member events, and legacy benefits.

name: Day Pass Credits
description: Flexible day passes for drop-in climbing. Buy credits and use them anytime. Perfect for irregular schedules or visiting climbers.

name: Private Coaching Session
description: One-on-one session with a professional climbing coach. Video analysis, technique correction, and personalized training plan.

name: Pro Climber Pass
description: Elite membership for serious climbers. Personal coaching, competition training, nutrition planning, and access to all partner gyms.

name: Crusher Pass
description: For dedicated climbers pushing their grade. 24/7 gym access, gear rentals, monthly technique clinics, and training board access.

name: Sender Pass
description: Perfect for casual climbers. Unlimited gym access during off-peak hours, locker rental, and access to beginner routes.
